_comment: Manual overrides — this is the only file you should ever have to hand-edit. Everything else is regenerated by the scraper on every run.
_cursorOverride: Set events/banners below to an ISO date (e.g. "2025-11-19") ONLY if you know Global has officially confirmed something past what bluearchive.wiki currently lists as GL. Leave null to trust the wiki's own GL data. NOTE: this only shifts the starting point for gap purposes — it can't cancel/change a gap on one specific item; for that use manualOverrides below instead (that's what it's for).
_manualOverrides: Pin one specific upcoming item to an exact date, e.g. when you know from an official Global announcement that it follows the previous one with no gap (or a different gap) than what JP's own history implies — the predictor otherwise replicates JP's actual gaps, see predict.mjs. `pairKey` is the OriginalId (events) or rate-up character name (banners) shown in the item's tooltip; `startDate` is "YYYY-MM-DD" (normalized onto the standard Tuesday 02:00 UTC reset). Only pins that one transition — every later item still auto-computes its own gap, chained from wherever this one lands. `note` is optional, purely for your own reference.

events.note: When Lore Pursuit Season 2 follows right after 'Pray-Ball! Swing for the Grand Slam!' all follow up events will line up with their respective banners

_manualNotes: Free-text reminders for yourself about predicted items worth double-checking by hand (anniversaries, collabs, anything that doesn't follow JP's usual pattern) — the predictor still places them on the timeline as normal, this is just where you jot down what to fix.
